notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: EO 12348 (February 25, 1982) established the Property Review Board and set Federal real property review duties for the Board, the Administrator of General Services and executive agencies, and revoked EO 11954 (Sec. 8). It has no own-terms sunset. EO 12512 of April 29, 1985 states in its Sec. 4 that Executive Order No. 12348 of February 25, 1982 "is hereby revoked", and replaces the framework with a new real property management order. The status is NO: the order was expressly and wholly revoked on April 29, 1985 and no held source revives it.
